description.value: Beijing Hot Pot (京門涮肉) is a hot pot restaurant located in a unit at 8251 Westminster Highway in Richmond, BC. Hot pot dining is a communal, interactive style of Chinese cuisine where diners cook ingredients in a simmering broth at the table, making it a warming and social stop. The restaurant maintains an Instagram presence under @beijing_hotpotvan.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (covered) at 59m; rack (covered) at 88m; rack (covered) at 88m.
